title: BlackLanturn 1.1.33
summary: Consistent landscape browsing cards and reversible title recommendations.

sections.heading: Consistent landscape cards
bullets: Title, season and episode cards keep a landscape frame as you browse and move to the next page.
Available wide artwork is preferred. Poster-only fallbacks stay centered without stretching; season and episode labels stay readable.

sections.heading: Control titles in discovery
bullets: Hide an exact movie or show, or choose Show less without reducing an entire genre.
Undo immediately, or restore titles from Settings → Recommendations. Search, My Stuff and watched progress remain accessible.

sections.heading: Your setup stays saved
bullets: Use Update BlackLanturn to retain settings, accounts, sources, authorizations, progress and other installed add-ons.
Both branded icon packs remain included. Personal Fight Zone stays outside public packages.
